description: MD-Blocks to paginated PDF using the canonical nui_wc2 renderer. Supports semantic page-break controls, repeated document chrome, and exact PDF page rasters for visual review.

tools.name: print_render
tools.description: Render an MD-Blocks Markdown document through nui_wc2 to PDF in MCP storage. Use breakBefore/breakAfter with MD-Blocks IDs to adjust pagination; caller arrays override frontmatter print.breakBefore/print.breakAfter. preset=page-break and frontmatter print.sectionPages are also honoured. Frontmatter print.chrome ({ background, color }) sets the repeated header/footer colours; it is document-defined and cannot be passed as a render argument. With preview enabled (default), rasterizes the finished PDF through PDFium, writes every page PNG, and attaches selected pages so the model can inspect actual break points. Returns a render.json sidecar with the resolved options (including chrome) and the available break-target IDs. A human-facing direct page editor is available at /print.

path.description: Markdown source: storage-relative or absolute path. Required unless markdown is given.

markdown.description: Inline MD-Blocks Markdown. Mutually exclusive with path.

basePath.description: Base directory for relative media when markdown is inline. Storage-relative or absolute; defaults to the storage root.

style.description: Unshaded print design: editorial (Segoe UI/navy), minimal (compact black-and-white), or classic (serif/traditional). Default editorial.

format.description: Page format. Overrides frontmatter print.format; default A4.

orientation.description: Page orientation. Overrides frontmatter print.orientation; default portrait.

margin.description: CSS page margin: one mm/cm/in/px value for all sides, or an object with top/right/bottom/left. Overrides frontmatter print.margin.

breakBefore.description: MD-Blocks IDs that must start a new page. Unknown or duplicate targets fail loudly.

breakAfter.description: MD-Blocks IDs after which a page break is forced.

sectionPages.description: Start every MD-Blocks section on a new page. Overrides frontmatter print.sectionPages.

preview.description: Rasterize PDF pages and attach previews. Default true.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers to attach inline. All pages are still written to pages/ when preview is enabled; defaults to the first 8.

width.description: Preview raster width in pixels; default 1240.

tools.name: print_preview
tools.description: Rasterize selected pages of an existing PDF through PDFium and attach the exact page images for visual inspection. Writes PNGs under storage/prints and returns their paths. Pages are 1-based.

width.description: Preview raster width in pixels; default 1240.
